newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares gain to record high.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares gain to record high.

text.p: Lithuanian shares climbed strongly to reach a new high on Friday amid busy trade, dealers said.
Overall central market volume was 1.57 million litas and the index rose 55.11 points to a record 1,929.16.
Bloc trades worth 10.99 million litas were made and Ukio Bank registered trade of 10.94 million litas at a price range of 22 to 12 litas.
"There is more activity on the bourse as it gives investors a better profit than government T-bills or deposit accounts in banks," one dealer said.
"Also, the annual financial reports from companies are starting to be announced," he added.
Birzai Milk rose to nine litas from 8.2 litas on 406,602 litas while TV screen maker Ekranas maintained its rapid rise to 3.6 litas from three litas on trade of 22,320 litas.
Among banks on the central market, Ukio Bankas was the most active and rose to 22 litas from 19.01 litas on business of 283,470 litas.
Another dealer said that money which had spurred an increase in the shares of fellow Baltic state Estonia over the last two weeks was finding its way to Lithuania.
Secondary T-bill market trade was 2.97 million litas.
